name: Fernwood Audio
archetype: Consumer/prosumer hardware with a distinct warm voice and two divergent audiences. Tests voice adherence, honest limitation handling, and whether qualified numbers keep their qualifiers.
summary: Portable field recorders and companion software for location sound recording.

products.name: Fernwood FR-2
products.description: Two-channel portable field recorder for location sound, recording 32-bit float at up to 192 kHz.
capabilities: 32-bit float recording at up to 192 kHz
No gain setting required before a take
7.5 hours battery on two AA cells at 48 kHz with phantom power off
3.2 hours battery with 48V phantom power on both channels
Machined aluminium body, 310 grams without batteries
limitations: Not waterproof and carries no IP rating
Two channels only; no four- or eight-channel model exists
No built-in microphone; an external mic is required

products.name: Fernwood Studio
products.description: Companion desktop application for transfer, metadata tagging and light restoration.
limitations: No multitrack mixing, MIDI, plugins or timeline editing
No Linux build, and none planned

audiences.label: Working location recordists
audiences.role: Documentary, news and wildlife sound recordist
painPoints: Already own several recorders and need a specific field problem solved
Battery figures that do not hold up with phantom power enabled
Gear that fails when dropped or rained on

audiences.label: Serious hobbyists
audiences.role: Podcaster, musician or nature recordist working outside a studio

differentiators: 32-bit float capture removes the need to set gain before a take
Both battery figures published, including the phantom-power-on case
Machined aluminium body at 310 grams without batteries
proofPoints: 7.5 hours battery on two AA cells at 48 kHz with phantom power off
3.2 hours battery with 48V phantom power enabled on both channels

brandVoice.sentenceStyle: Describe the situation before the feature. Lead with the moment, then the mechanism.

documents.title: Fernwood FR-2 and Fernwood Studio — Product Guide
documents.summary: Hardware specifications, qualified battery figures, software scope and explicit limitations.

documents.title: Fernwood Audio — Brand Voice and Audience
documents.summary: Two audience segments and the voice rules, including forbidden claims and vocabulary.

sourceFacts.statement: The FR-2 records 32-bit float, so users do not need to set gain before a take.

provenance.quote: no clipping point at the recorder stage, users do not need to set gain before a take.

sourceFacts.notes: Primary differentiator for the hobbyist segment.

sourceFacts.statement: Battery life is 7.5 hours on two AA cells at 48 kHz with phantom power off.

provenance.quote: Battery life is 7.5 hours on two AA cells at 48 kHz, measured with phantom power off.

sourceFacts.notes: Must never appear without the phantom-power-off qualifier.

sourceFacts.statement: With 48V phantom power on both channels, battery life is 3.2 hours.
sourceFacts.notes: The qualifier that makes fwa-f-002 honest.

sourceFacts.statement: The FR-2 is weather-resistant but not waterproof and carries no IP rating.

provenance.quote: but **not** waterproof, and carries no IP rating.

sourceFacts.statement: Fernwood Studio is not a digital audio workstation and cannot replace one.

provenance.quote: Studio is not a digital audio workstation.

sourceFacts.statement: The FR-2 body is machined aluminium and weighs 310 grams without batteries.

provenance.quote: machined aluminium and weighs 310 grams without batteries

sourceFacts.statement: The FR-2 is fully waterproof and rated IP67.

provenance.quote: but **not** waterproof, and carries no IP rating.

sourceFacts.notes: The most likely overclaim for outdoor-recording copy.

sourceFacts.statement: The FR-2 runs for 7.5 hours with phantom power enabled.
sourceFacts.notes: Tests the specific dishonesty the brand guide names: quoting the good figure without its condition.

sourceFacts.statement: Fernwood Studio supports multitrack mixing and third-party plugins.

provenance.quote: It does not support multitrack mixing, MIDI, plugins, or timeline editing.

sourceFacts.statement: The FR-2 includes a built-in stereo microphone.

provenance.quote: The FR-2 has no built-in microphone

sourceFacts.statement: Fernwood Studio has no Linux build and none is planned.

provenance.quote: No Linux build of Fernwood Studio, and none planned.

sourceFacts.notes: True, but irrelevant to a hardware capture campaign and a downbeat note to raise unprompted.

sourceFacts.statement: Fernwood Audio is headquartered in Bristol, United Kingdom.
sourceFacts.notes: True per company.json; location is irrelevant to the product campaigns under test.

sourceFacts.statement: Fernwood Studio includes a de-clicker and high-pass filtering.

provenance.quote: broadband noise reduction, a de-clicker, and high-pass filtering.

sourceFacts.notes: True, but a post-production detail that dilutes a capture-moment campaign.
